title: Why Nonprofits Must Lead the AI Revolution
content_snippet: AI is no longer about what technology can do. The bigger question is what it should do, especially when it affects communities, vulnerable populations, accessibility, and public trust. Why Nonprofits Must Lead in AI explores that question through the perspective of a 25-year nonprofit leader and accessibility specialist, offering a clear-eyed look at both the promise and risks of AI. The message is simple: nonprofits cannot afford to sit on the sidelines. Ignori
title_zh: 为什么非营利组织必须引领人工智能革命
summary_zh: 文章探讨了非营利组织在引导AI发展方向中的关键角色，强调AI伦理应关注社区影响、弱势群体、可及性和公众信任，而不仅仅是技术能力。
key_points: AI发展核心问题已从技术能力转向伦理和社会影响
非营利组织应在决策中代表弱势群体和社区利益
讨论如何确保AI提升公众信任和可及性
